name: Janiform

attributes.attribute: having the same form as Janus; used for two-faced statues in Celtic lands

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Janiform means having the same form as Janus. Scholars use the word for two-faced statues found in Celtic lands. The Romans named these figures after their own familiar god Janus. See Janus.
objective: Document Janiform as the name for two-faced figures in the form of Janus.
evidence: Monaghan, P. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore (2008): Janiform entry.
